NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is required for video study sessions and setting a profile photo.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required for voice study rooms and communication.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is required to choose a profile photo and share files in rooms.
NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Notification permissions are required to alert you when pomodoro and break timers complete.
